'''Leilana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] and the lover of [[Jayn]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Leilana tried to persuade Jayn to retire from mercenary work and to settle with her on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]], but Jayn kept putting the idea off until he finished the next job. Leilana [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point without seeing Jayn settle into a peaceful life. In honor of her, Jayn name his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Leilana's Dagger]]''.<ref name="RF4" />
